limitations: Ordinary List: Full native fields, types, exact decimals, nested values and unknown fields are retained. Inquiry-only List; no Get or additional history/detail requests.
Width 1000 is qualified for complete acquisition, not a measured backend maximum. SDK collection owns loops, deadlines, retries, quality and cache publication.
Duplicates, count gaps and short interior pages remain incomplete. Conflicts keep the last arrival; strict refresh rejects incomplete data and preserves the prior saved capture.
Tenant GUAPW3SG history, with paging only; no invented dates or local filters. Native tradeDate/valueDate and rates/amounts remain unchanged.
Native forward root; no hedging order acquisition or amount/date reinterpretation.
Get and supported List --live --with-detail preserve native types, nesting and unknown fields, perform no implicit history/child inquiries, and write no cache or Duckdog data.
